This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin and tall, pointed [[Bone|craniums]] with outward pointing [[ear]]s.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Anteater-Like-And-Pointy-Headed-Species.png|left|200px|thumb|A member of this species in a bacta tank within the Lina Soh Hospital.]]
In [[3 BBY]], a member of this species was present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], and later attended a gathering hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> A year later, at least one member of this species still frequented the Senate Building,<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> witnessing [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> During the following year, a member of this species was suspended within a [[bacta tank]] in the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] while [[Kleya Marki]] infiltrated the building in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]] sometime prior to the production for the season, not for a specific project or franchise, but instead simply as a design to showcase his skills to potential clients on his portfolio website.<ref name="LW Concept">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-19.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-19}}</ref> During the design process for the show, Wiltshire was allowed to use old unaffiliated designs such as this one when tasked with creating a "generic" alien design for the creature department.<ref name="LW Generic">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-20.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-20}}</ref>
